note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. The room, clerk, identifier and both states are generic and fictional; 'archived' is only another tray and shelf block in this configured example. Nothing states a retention period, an access or destruction rule, an archiving procedure, a time span or any outcome; the old value is kept as 'was', never struck.
